title: Strengthen the failed-retirement-save test so a dropped resume dispatch fails it, not only a missing WaitConsumed delta
outcome: acceptance_spawn_unacknowledged_first_brief_hands_off_a_wait_when_the_retirement_save_fails (src/tests/acceptance_evaluation_spawn_ack.rs) also observes the resume-dispatch boundary. It asserts that the parent's wait-resume prompt was queued and that its dispatch was attempted (dispatch_delegation_wait_resumes ran for that parent), so a regression that publishes the delegationWaitConsumed delta but skips publish_delegation_refresh_side_effects fails the test. It also shows the queued resume stays recoverable while persistence is unavailable.
acceptance: Deleting the publish_delegation_refresh_side_effects call in retire_unacknowledged_acceptance_evaluator's failed-save path makes the strengthened test fail, while the current code passes it.
The test asserts on the parent's queued or dispatched wait-resume prompt, not only on the delegationWaitConsumed delta.
